function.name: search_symbols
function.description: Find US-listed stocks or ETFs by ticker or company name. Use when the user mentions a company without a ticker or the ticker is ambiguous.

function.name: get_quote
function.description: Latest end-of-day quote for a US ticker: close, change, range, volume and 52-week extremes.

symbol.description: Uppercase ticker, e.g. NVDA or BRK.B.

function.name: get_price_history
function.description: Daily price history summary for a ticker over a range: return, high/low, volatility, max drawdown and weekly closes.

function.name: get_technical_indicators
function.description: Deterministically computed technical indicators (SMA, EMA, RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, ATR) with rule-based signals for a ticker.

function.name: get_fundamentals
function.description: Reported financial statement data from SEC filings with derived margins and growth rates.

function.name: get_forecast
function.description: Probabilistic price forecast bands (P10, P50, P90) for 3, 6, 9 and 12 month horizons, with the method and data source.
